name: floor-attack
description: The spam shape the per-peer quota defends against: the low-floor peer R forwards 120 sub-floor payments per block and nothing valid (a peer relaying for nobody), eight bursts; measured are the declines the strict node S processes from R per block (bounded by R's budget) and the unrelated peer Q's valid payments at S (delayed past the next block, unmined after the wait). Below the activity floor (fewer than 4 intervals with 50 declines at S, or fewer than 40 valid sends from Q) a run is INCONCLUSIVE. Expectations: on either jar Q's payments are not lost; the per-interval decline count is the measurement.
